subject: PH
stem: Two groups: one previously used omega-3 (exposed), one never, followed forward for events. Study type?
explanation: Exposed vs non-exposed followed forward = cohort. Remember: cohort = exposure → outcome; case-control = outcome → exposure.

subject: PH
stem: Regression intercept for gestation = 37.9 weeks. Meaning?
options: B. Mean gestation when all X=0
explanation: Intercept = predicted Y when all predictors zero. Check centring – may be non-physiological, just model anchor.

subject: PH
stem: Test detects disease earlier but death age unchanged. Bias?
explanation: Screening survival illusion: earlier diagnosis without delayed death = lead-time. Length-time is slow-growing cases over-represented.

subject: PH
stem: Correlation between dose and weight gain (continuous). Measure?
explanation: Two continuous → Pearson r / linear regression. OR/RR for binary outcomes; chi-square for categorical.

subject: PH
stem: Outbreak: 40 ill of 200 exposed. Attack rate?
explanation: Attack rate = ill/exposed during outbreak. Guide control + source search.

subject: PH
stem: Herd immunity threshold for measles (~95%) rationale?
options: A. Protects unvaccinated by breaking chains when coverage high
explanation: High coverage stops transmission, shielding infants/immunocompromised. Measles needs ~95% due to R0 12–18.

subject: PH
stem: Child up-to-date except MMR at 14 months in endemic area. Advice?
options: B. Give MMR now per schedule; no extra later beyond routine second dose – explain timing ≥12 mo for maternal antibody waning
explanation: MMR ≥12 mo (maternal antibodies wane). Give now + second at 4–6y. Early dose (<12 mo) during outbreak doesn't count.

subject: PH
stem: What is the best first-line smoking-cessation help?
options: B. Behavioural counselling + NRT/varenicline/cytisine per eligibility
explanation: Combine behavioural + pharmacotherapy doubles quit rates. Screen, advise, assess, assist, arrange.

subject: PH
stem: How often should diabetic retinopathy screening occur?
options: B. Annual dilated eye exam from diagnosis (T2) / 5 years after diagnosis (T1); urgent referral if blurred vision with dot-blot haemorrhages (macular oedema)
explanation: Recall-linked: dot-blot + gradual blur with clear vitreous/normal IOP → diabetic maculopathy. Annual screen prevents blindness.

subject: PH
stem: Confounding example: coffee–MI confounded by smoking. How to handle it at the design stage?
explanation: Design: randomise/match/restrict; Analysis: stratify/adjust. Confounder linked to exposure + outcome, not on pathway.

subject: PH
options: A. Tap water + street food always
B. Safe water/food + hand hygiene + standby ORS/azithromycin per destination; vaccines (hep A/typhoid) as indicated
explanation: Food/water precautions + vaccines + ORS plan. Prophylactic antibiotics not routine except special groups.
